    SELECT 'legacy_copy_omitted_child',e.child_revision_id FROM __LEAF__.legacy_copy_origin root_origin
    JOIN __BASE_LEAF__.custom_import_family_child e ON e.family_revision_id=root_origin.base_family_revision_id
    WHERE root_origin.kind='root' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM __LEAF__.legacy_copy_origin child_origin
        WHERE child_origin.kind='child' AND child_origin.family_revision_id=root_origin.family_revision_id
            AND child_origin.base_child_revision_id=e.child_revision_id AND child_origin.collection_slot=e.collection_slot)
) violation LIMIT 1;

    SELECT DISTINCT root_record_id FROM (
        (SELECT root_record_id FROM __LEAF__.custom_import_build_family
         WHERE build_id=$1 AND ($2 IS NULL OR root_record_id>$2)
         ORDER BY root_record_id LIMIT $3)
        UNION ALL
        (SELECT DISTINCT root_record_id FROM __LEAF__.custom_import_build_occurrence

           AND root_record_id IS NOT NULL AND ($2 IS NULL OR root_record_id>$2)
         ORDER BY root_record_id LIMIT $3)
    ) candidates ORDER BY root_record_id LIMIT $3
) roots
